title: pternandra verrucosa
intro: Pternandra verrucosa, commonly known as the 'Red Backed Pternandra', is a species of flowering plant in the family Sapindaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which aid in relieving pain and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents present in Pternandra verrucosa include alkaloids, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
